Buttons in the colors of the theme chosen in the top bar, the same in Wicket, React and Svelte: one style sheet, antilia-button.css, draws them all.

In Wicket, an AjaxActionButton runs an action via Ajax and shows a text, an icon and a text, or only an icon, whose text is then its tooltip and the name screen readers say. A ButtonBehavior draws any link or form button as one. Each comes in four variants, primary, secondary, ghost and danger, and three sizes, small, medium and large. React and Svelte have a Button component taking the same variants and sizes.

"Icons" chooses the icons of the buttons: the Font Awesome icons as inline SVG (SvgIcon), or the same drawn by the Font Awesome font (FontAwesomeIcon). A button takes any IIcon, and the React and Svelte Button any markup.
